coordinate_mapping.scene_mapping: A compiler must declare one fixed plan-to-scene transform and use it for every shell, aperture, object, and camera target; it may not mirror one class independently.
coordinate_mapping.invariant: Accepted left/right ordering and orientation in plan space must be preserved in scene space.

immutability.z_only_refinement: z height, extrusion, materials, and silhouette detail may change only without changing accepted object or architecture x/y/orientation.
immutability.provenance: Use source_proven geometry first, owner_verified relationships second, and provisional detail last. Never promote a provisional choice into spatial truth.

rules: Treat wall contour rings as one even-odd wall topology, not independent solid polygons.
Compile the balcony from balcony.footprint's closed ring and shared architectural edge; never from a decorative open polyline.

Resolve each aperture against its named parent_wall_id and host_face_id; segment_gu is the immutable approved trace collinear with that face's explicit bearing_line_gu, not a collinearity requirement on the wall's semantic edge.

Construct the opening perpendicular to the named host face through the full host wall volume before capping, glass assignment, or visibility treatment; do not project or snap segment_gu to a semantic edge.
Preserve aperture jambs/posts, corners, headers/lintels, and sills/thresholds as parent architecture.
Do not fill a registered door aperture when extruding walls.
For registered windows, add provisional sill/lintel/glass geometry rather than leaving a floor-to-ceiling gap.
Window and door z dimensions are provisional and may change without altering aperture x/y spans.
Render floors and floor-plane rugs as underlays beneath walls and furniture; they must not painter-sort over wall faces or clip objects sitting on them.
Model the bedroom bed as a lower base/mattress plus a separate west-wall headboard; keep its accepted footprint clear of walls and add two pillows as separate provisional-z objects.
Model the bedroom PC tower under the desk on the accepted opposite/left side; relationship provenance is owner_verified.
Model the projector on the thin desk return, aimed only by its accepted plan relationship; relationship provenance is source_proven.
Model the microwave above the stove/oven in z-space.
Model the shower as a low tray plus enclosure edges: only its intended camera/front-facing enclosure span may be glass; fixed side/back architecture remains opaque.
Model the vanity with a visible basin and an upright faucet on the wall/back side facing into that basin.
Model the toilet with contained tank/pedestal/bowl sub-shapes inside its approved footprint; do not extrude the whole top-down oval into the shower divider.
Model laundry as recognizable washing/drying equipment within the accepted laundry footprint; presence is owner_verified and arrangement/form factor remains provisional.
Treat kitchen pendants as exactly two suspended overhead objects at the accepted one-third/two-thirds island positions; their plan projection must not be mistaken for sink hardware.
Camera yaw/pitch may change only after topology and z-model sanity validation passes; camera_v1.json remains the locked desktop hero camera.
sanity_gate: No duplicate, protruding, or impossible wall solid is emitted from the even-odd topology.
Bedroom door remains in the approved location and its posts/corners remain opaque architecture.
Bedroom translucent treatment affects only named wall faces, never bathroom boundaries, aperture structure, or the bedroom/living projector divider.
Kitchen island preserves approved orientation and pendant positions.
Living chair/couch/TV relationships match the top-down plan; the white chair sits on the rug and the rug stops before the couch.
Registered windows remain semantic apertures rather than missing or filled walls.
Closet opening is treated as a double/folding door, not an anonymous wall gap.
Vanity basin/faucet and shower glass/opaque faces remain recognizable and correctly assigned.
Washer and dryer are recognizable within the laundry footprint without inventing an unverified arrangement.
No camera candidate is valid if it makes approved room/opening/object relationships appear to move or rotate.
